title: Showdown 2.0.0 Gallery
lede: Build: gameplay/r87 187a67c0, with Trophy Room, final Gazette and Rule Book scoring re-shot on e0b7eb85, and the Transfer War wording (#1190) re-shot on release candidate bd67147a: roulette card, Prime Pack exit and Rule Book. Release: 2026-11-02 05:00 UTC. Every shot waits for animations to finish. r87, build 2.0.0. Changed screens only, one desktop (1440x900, Daniel) and one phone (390x844, Nik) shot each, played on the emulator by CE2PG. Tap any picture to open it full size.

screens.title: Home
screens.note: Music strip removed from Home at every size (the desktop top-bar player and phone MUSIC tab stay); tiles never under the tab bar. Gold Continue tile, no dimming; a double tap no longer opens the wrong screen.

screens.title: Seasons
screens.note: Four gold chips for 1, 3, 5 and 10 seasons and the NEW SHOWDOWN wordmark. REMATCH opens this with the length already picked.

screens.title: Select League, waiting
screens.note: Waiting strip sits low under SPIN WHEEL; waiting buttons are solid black and gold, not see-through.

screens.title: Club Assignment
screens.note: CLUBS LOCKED panel on solid marble (phone); lock note stays inside the deck (desktop).

screens.title: Special Player reveal
screens.note: Smoother on phones, LED boards show whole messages, Continue no longer dimmed while waiting.

screens.title: Career Start
screens.note: Option B: its own stage on the Club plate, club crests inside the packs, nothing over the faces or wordmark.

screens.title: Russian Roster Roulette, the scene
screens.note: Seven chambers, one bullet. Daniel spins first. Boards are each club's FIFA 17 launch squad in its real formation. Pictures from the roulette fix PR (#1095); the look was polished again in #1123 (nickel drum, title steps aside), at 1366x768 and 390x844: headless Chromium here has no WebGL, so CE2PG plays this step on the result panel.

screens.title: Russian Roster Roulette, result
screens.note: Re-shot on bd67147a (#1190). Your result on a marble panel: release the player who was hit in FIFA 17 "before the Transfer War", then I'VE RELEASED HIM; a safe squad goes straight on with GO TO THE PRIME PACK. Order is always roulette, Prime Pack, Transfer War.

screens.title: Showdown Home, waiting for the spin
screens.note: The transfer window waits until both managers have spun; the button names who it waits for.

screens.title: Prime Pack
screens.note: Re-shot on bd67147a. After the roulette, a Prime Pack opens on a marble podium (Team V art) and one masked Icon card rises. Each stage adds a stat; the first right name scores 4, 3, 2 or 1; 2 guesses each. The exit button now says GO TO THE TRANSFER WAR.

extra.caption: Desktop, the pack before the card rises
Phone, the pack before the card rises

screens.title: Transfer War
screens.note: Each signing takes FIFA 17 overall and position. Official 2016-17 league names, full scrolling search lists, faces clear on laptops. Window clock is the hero on laptops; RELEASE and KEEP stamps.

screens.title: Season Results entry
screens.note: Result entry form.

screens.title: Season Results with Commentary v3
screens.note: Two-voice TV bar in the SEASON SCORE box: COMMENTARY plus BY THE NUMBERS, from your own results only.

screens.title: Touchline Gazette, season edition
screens.note: A front page after each season, the same on both phones, no extra reads.

screens.title: Final Winner
screens.note: Three equal exit buttons including REMATCH.

screens.title: Touchline Gazette, final edition
screens.note: Re-shot on e0b7eb85. Covers the whole Showdown; the last season goes straight here. The record lines (INSIDE TODAY: best season, seasons won, trophies) use the 15-point season.

screens.title: Standings
screens.note: Title block at the same height on both tabs (phone).

screens.title: Career Statistics
screens.note: Big numbers and 7-8 digit pairs fit; Special Player names wrap; level leaders show a split face.

screens.title: Trophy Room
screens.note: Re-shot on e0b7eb85. CAREER DETAILS heading on solid marble; NOT WON YET for trophies not won. All-time records count a perfect season as 15 points (none in this test game, so it shows a dash). The first tap on OPEN TROPHY ROOM opens it.

extra.caption: Phone, MORE: all-time records (most perfect seasons counts 15-point seasons only)

screens.title: Legacy
screens.note: History opens on the newest Showdown; season history is now a table (season, both managers, result); fast with hundreds of Showdowns. Desktop picture from the 9a9667fb run (this run's desktop capture timed out).

screens.title: Rivalry Statistics
screens.note: Unchanged layout, shown for the career numbers.

screens.title: Settings
screens.note: Shared reads meter: both phones show the same free use today and seasons left. Desktop picture from the 14:40 UTC freeze build (later desktop captures timed out; Settings is unchanged since).

screens.title: Rule Book
screens.note: Re-shot on bd67147a. Card 03 is now TRANSFER WAR: roulette, board and guessed-player lines. The scoring card shows maximum 15 a season and Golden Showdown 150.

extra.caption: Desktop, Scoring: maximum 15 a season, Golden Showdown 150
